description: This source file contains implementations for AST traversers and functions to emulate certain OpenGL built-in variables (gl_DrawID, gl_BaseVertex, gl_BaseInstance) as uniforms in shader code, specifically for the ANGLE project.

classes.name: FindGLDrawIDTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser to find the gl_DrawID builtin variable.

classes.name: AddBaseVertexToGLVertexIDTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser to add gl_BaseVertex to gl_VertexID.

classes.name: FindGLBaseVertexTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser to find the gl_BaseVertex builtin variable.

classes.name: FindGLBaseInstanceTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser to find the gl_BaseInstance builtin variable.

methods.name: EmulateGLDrawID
methods.description: Function to emulate gl_DrawID as a uniform variable.

methods.name: EmulateGLBaseVertexBaseInstance
methods.description: Function to emulate gl_BaseVertex and gl_BaseInstance as uniforms, with optional addition to gl_VertexID.
